notes.title: Version update and participation of this demo in the June New Product Festival
notes.notes:
Version: Beta 3
🎇 The current version is beta version 3, which is open for trial as a free demo. 🎇
⭐⭐ This game can currently complete the first and second chapters, with a speed pass time of about 4 hours. ⭐⭐
⏱️ If played normally under unknown conditions, the time will be around 6 hours. After clearing all task maps, it will take 10 hours. ⏱️

❗ If you are using an old version of the archive, you need to pay attention after updating the version. ❗
❌ 1. The archive of Beta 1 cannot be used in Beta 2 and Beta 3. ❌
❗ If your character level is too high in the save of Beta 2, there will be fewer skills in Beta 3. ❗

The following are the details of the updated content:
1. The game content will advance to the second chapter, and the difficulty will increase in the latter half of the second chapter. 📚
2. Additional treasure chests have been added to the map process as rewards for exploring the maze. 📦
3. New item update, including synthetic materials, but the synthetic function is only enabled in Chapter 3 (Beta 3 does not include the content of Chapter 3). 🧰
4. Quick teleportation function: Due to the excessive number of forks in Chapter 2, an automatic pathfinding function is provided to prevent getting lost. ✈️
5.2 temporary characters will be temporarily added to the main storyline to enrich the diversity of the lineup. 🧑‍🤝‍🧑
In combat scenes, by touching the status icon with the mouse, the specific effects of all statuses will be displayed. 🖱️
7. Several disposable consumables have been added, but the quantity is limited and you cannot replenish them in the store. 🐽
8. Added more adventure dialogues, mainly used to declare the importance of equipment and items. 🥰

Some key points: Convenient features within the game. ✍️
Equipment grade: Equipment uses star symbols ★ and color changes to indicate equipment grade, with higher grades indicating stronger equipment. 🥇
Equipment classification: The beginning of the equipment will be marked with three types: Armor, Equipment, and Accessories, corresponding to their respective equipment columns. 🪙
So you don't need to determine which equipment should be located where, as it has already been labeled.
Status details: Only in combat scenes, hovering over the status icon with the mouse will display annotations for all obtained statuses. 🎨
Wayfinding system: Only in mainline tasks, some tasks will prompt to omit the pathfinding process, and you can choose to automatically find your way to the task location. 🚀
Task information: In the main menu, task information marks what you currently need to do. The task location and specific direction indicated in the text prompt. 🏷️

notes.title: The game content has been updated
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated once, but I forgot to announce it due to my lack of proficiency in operation 😹。

Functional changes
1. Detailed display of attribute additions and deletions brought by equipment.
2. Simplify the information on the equipment interface for a more intuitive comparison.
3. Equipped with a maximum of 6 equipment (previously 7), including 1 weapon, 1 armor, 2 equipment, and 2 accessories.
4. Optimize the display effect of the dialog box, make the information more concentrated, and increase the text size by 10 (original 26).
5. Replace with new text and interface.
6. The items sold by equipment merchants become clearer, making it easier for you to understand what props different types of merchants sell.
7. Add a small map display located in the upper left corner of the screen, with the white area inaccessible, so you don't have to worry about getting lost.
🥰 [b] Attention: The mini map function is not compatible with the old save, so open a new save to play. [/b]
Process Change
1. You can come out of the basement now.
2. Unlocked a new large map - city-state, as well as corresponding tasks and explorable scenes.
3. The process has been increased from 1 hour to 2 hours (this is the result of the author's own self play, which may actually be higher).
4. Add new skills, but they will not be displayed in the old save. I suggest opening a new save to play.
5. Delayed the upgrade progress.
6. Revise the plot text to simplify sentences that cannot proceed with the process.
7. Chapter reminder: The content of the initial demo has been classified as Chapter 1 and can now be advanced to the first half of Chapter 2.

The demo will be updated again in the future, so that you can fully pass all the content of Chapter 2 (picture cake).
